[comment by gliscowo (member)]
This is a known bug fixed in 1.19. For preventing the crash on 1.18.2, you can use a [special build of owo](https://modrinth.com/mod/owo-lib/version/0.7.2-no-cme+1.18) which specifically fixes this bug
Cheers

A special build will unfortunately not work. I am the creator of Another Quality Modpack 2. Curseforge will not allow mods to be added that aren't actually on the mod's page. Could you please upload this to curseforge for 1.18.2 please? I will not be updating my pack to 1.19. I'd really appreciate it. This is a big bug that i'd love to get out of the way.
